# EndSelect

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
End Select
```

## Description

Ends a [Select](Select) block. It is written as two words, `End Select`. Without the space it is not a keyword.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Select 1
	Case 1 : Print "one"
End Select
```

```text
one
```

## Related Commands

[ElseIf](ElseIf), [EndIf](EndIf), [If](If), [Select](Select)
